title: 勝ちたくて、勝ちたいから！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a bad dream about losing in the Japanese Derby, Winning Ticket begins to panic and push herself too hard during training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I confront her about this, she confesses that she's scared of running in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We talk more, and I realize that she wants to win more than anyone. So I declare that her powerful feelings are her greatest strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Encouraged by those words and armed with determination, Winning Ticket yells into the night sky that she will win the Japanese Derby.
